req.title: Blog post title required on update
req.statement: The system shall reject POST /<id>/update with a missing title, rendering an error.
triggers: blog post title required on update

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-040 requires that POST /<id>/update rejects a missing title by re-rendering the update form with an error message (HTTP 200, not a redirect). Three test cases are designed: (1) positive — valid title+body yields a redirect (HTTP 302) confirming the happy path; (2) negative — empty title string yields HTTP 200 with 'Title is required.' error message; (3) boundary — title consisting of exactly one space character (whitespace-only, falsy in Python) also yields HTTP 200 with the error. Each test sets up its own isolated in-process Flask app with a temp database, logs in as user 'test' (author of post id=1), and makes assertions on exact status codes and exact error text to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_update_with_valid_title_redirects():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

test_update_with_valid_title_redirects()

preconditions: App initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Pre-loaded fixture: user id=1 (test/test), post id=1 authored by user 1
User 'test' is logged in via POST /auth/login
actions: POST /1/update with title=' ' (single space, falsy in Python) and body='some body'

trace: R-FLASKR-040: a whitespace-only title is falsy in Python and must be rejected

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_update_with_whitespace_only_title_shows_error():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': ' ', 'body': 'some body'})
    # A single space is falsy in Python (bool(' ') is False via `not title`)
    # so the SUT must re-render with the error, not redirect
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Title is required.' in r.data

test_update_with_whitespace_only_title_shows_error()
